headline: Alphabet Shares Drop Following Revenue Miss and Higher Cash Burn
summary: Alphabet stock fell after search advertising revenue missed expectations and capital spending led to worsening cash burn.
why: Alphabet is one of the world's largest digital advertising and cloud infrastructure companies, making its financial metrics a core market focus.

impacts.name: Alphabet Inc.
impacts.why: Slower search revenue growth alongside heavy spending reduced investor confidence in short-term profit margins.

why_moved: Quarterly search revenue missing estimates and growing cash burn driven by capital spending triggered equity selling.
